_doc: TRACK 2 RESULT: transfer-switch design sweep at the committed iso-current point (dV=1.0, L=277.8nH, RS=10, CA=35.979fF, 8 metered cells). Protocol amendments in AMENDMENT.md + this file. Rows: TRUE-ZCS (open at each design's own probe zero). As-committed(+50ps) rows in sweep_rows.json.

instrument_checks_MEASURED.G1_calib: sw_calib.cir.mt0 digit-identical to committed gateb/gb_calib.cir.mt0 (every measure equal); 1F-integrator static curve at committed checkpoints within 0.14% worst-case; static refs at Vend 0.5763: Q_sup 20.634/E_sup 7.144/E_in -3.144 vs RESULTS 20.633/7.143/-3.144. NOTE: raw .measure INTEGRAL E(0.167) reads -21.6% (the documented under-report trap; gateb's committed mt0 has the identical value 2.643496e-16, so this is the measure artifact, not the instrument).
instrument_checks_MEASURED.G2_baseline_repro: tg60 hop at t_half=342.0: VBPK 0.61132/VBEND 0.57630/VAEND 0.047519/IPK 195.19uA/QTR 33.80fC; ledger phases +8.274/+24.389/-1.951/-0.579 net 13.585 fC; E_hop 10.806/E_R 0.1457/cells 1.0350/switch 9.625 fJ -- all equal to gateb RESULTS.json to the digit. Closure Q -0.0038%, E -0.0049%.
instrument_checks_MEASURED.G3_closure: every reported run within 0.03% on Q and E closure (worst nm40 0.017%/0.028%)

protocol_amendments: A1 (AMENDMENT.md): committed t_zcs=342.0 is the TRUE ZERO (291.34ps after close) + 50ps; the +50ps late open interrupts ~-100uA and is only benign for the 60um switch (its ~55fF parks the ring). Off-baseline it un-transfers the rail (tg15: V_A recovers 0.12->0.59 after open). Primary rows re-based to TRUE ZCS.

A2: V_A_end and E_outA at the D checkpoint are RING-PHASE SNAPSHOTS: after open, the switch node's parasitic charge rings through L with bank A, tau=2L/RS~56ns, period ~500ps, measured V(bka) swing 0->0.76V for tg60-zcs; the committed row's V_A_end=0.0485 (and gateb's 0.0475) is a trough sample. Robust restatement: cut bank-A books at the open checkpoint: E_hop_open = ea_C - E_static_sup(VBEND). Committed anchor restates 10.81 -> 10.69 fJ (trough luck kept the committed headline nearly right).

A3: park-variant v1 (park gate tied to gtp) was an instrument failure: gtp is high pre-hop, park shorted bank A through L before close (~170uA pre-current, bogus ~100ps zeros, 2 Xyce aborts). v2 uses a dedicated pk control (0 until open+2ps). v1 decks/logs kept in park_drive.log.

verdict.curve: E_hop_open falls MONOTONICALLY with TG width: 11.31 (120um) / 10.66 (60um, committed) / 9.66-9.56 (30um/+park) / 8.48-8.38 (15um/+park) / 7.60-7.52 (7.5um/+park) fJ. NO interior W optimum in range: at iso-current the conduction loss never bites (E_R to open ~0.05 fJ flat; switch conduction inside switch_related also falls with W). The predicted charge~W vs conduction~1/W trade is real but its crossover lies BELOW 7.5um total, where rail-drain completeness fails first (VA_open 0.145-0.162 > anchor 0.095).
verdict.binding_constraints: (1) rail drain: VA_open (ring-free, =1-qlt_C/CA) is 0.095 for the committed anchor itself; tg15p 0.098 matches it, tg30p 0.053 beats it, tg7p5p 0.162 FAILS. (2) below ~30um the RAW topology breaks post-open (off-switch reconnection pumps the banks; rails subsidize B) -- the 1um park nMOS on node sw (control: off till open) restores clean books. (3) the park costs drive-rail energy at turn-off (+5.5..+13.4 fJ net rails) which is a real loss unless the drive infrastructure recycles it (committed metric assumes ideal rails, which ALSO credits the committed 60um design its -14 fJ export).
verdict.optimum: tg15p: TG wn=5/wp=10um + 1um park (total 16um vs 60um committed). E_hop_open 8.38 fJ = -21.6% vs the 10.69 committed anchor (committed-metric E_hop_D 8.41 vs 10.81, -22%). Rail drains as well as the committed row (VA_open 0.098 vs 0.095), delivers MORE swing (VBEND 0.676 vs 0.576, cells 100% settled), and is FASTER: true zero 266.8 vs 291.3 ps (-8.4%). Conservative pick if the cells canary and rails flag are hard gates: tg30p, 9.56 fJ (-11%), VA_open 0.053, cells 1.43 fJ, rails +13.4.
verdict.per_gate_settle: at tg15p: 8.38/8 = 1.048 fJ/gate (committed 10.74/8 = 1.343; robust anchor restatement 10.69/8 = 1.336). At tg30p: 1.195 fJ/gate. Caveat: delivered at VBEND 0.676 (0.632) not 0.576 -- more swing per hop; retuning dV/L back to the committed swing would bank further savings (not measured here).
verdict.cells_canary: cells_burn is swing-driven, not an instrument fault: 1.13 fJ @VBEND 0.585, 1.43 @0.632, 1.70 @0.676, 1.90 @0.698 (monotone in VBEND; cells_excess_Q stays 0.02-0.09 fC, no crowbar; outputs settle exactly). At the committed swing it reproduces 1.035. Rows above VBEND 0.63 exceed the pre-registered [0.88,1.20] band and are flagged.
verdict.nmos_only: FAILS at every width (5/10/20/40um) with the 1.5V gate rail -- but not by failing to pass the bank peak: (i) the rail never drains (VA_open 0.34-0.64; source-follower clamp near the top of the A->B swing), (ii) turn-on gate feedthrough pumps 9.2-16.4 fC into the bank (VBPK up to 0.85), (iii) post-open B droops 0.1-0.33V back through the off device, (iv) cells burn 2.2-4.9 fJ. Honest headroom answer: conduction margin exists (Vgs~0.9V at the peak) yet the topology still fails on charge dynamics.
verdict.tgap_2to1: reduced-pMOS TG (10/5um) FAILS rail drain (VA_open 0.273): the pMOS half does the top-of-swing work; halving it stalls the drain.
